module.title: Turn on Finances to get started
module.body: Log the couple's expenses, see who owes whom, track bills and a budget. You can turn it off any time without losing anything.
module.offHelp: Turning it off only hides the module. Expenses, balance and bills stay saved and come back when you turn it on again.

form.amountInvalid: Enter an amount between R$ 0.01 and R$ 10,000,000.00.

card.label: Card
card.name: Card name
card.hint: Only you see your cards. Last digits, closing and due days are optional.

installments.past: The first installment is in the past. Installments already due go into the next settlement.
installments.editHint: This expense is an installment. To change the amount or the number of installments, delete the purchase and log it again.

conflict.current: Someone else changed this expense. It is now {{amount}} ({{description}}). What you typed was kept: save again to apply it.

expenses.emptyBody: Log the first expense of the month. It goes into the balance and summary right away.
expenses.emptyMine: You haven't logged personal expenses this month. Only you see them unless you choose to show your partner.

detail.confirmDelete: Delete this expense? This can't be undone.
detail.settledHint: This expense is part of a settlement and can't change. To correct it, log an adjustment expense.

group.title: Installment purchase
group.editHint: Applies only to open installments. To change the amount or the number of installments, delete the purchase and log it again.

balance.title: Balance
balance.through: Expenses through {{date}}. Future installments don't count yet.
balance.singleBody: You can already log expenses. Once the other person joins, the balance shows up here.

settle.title: Settle up
settle.offline: The app only records it. The payment happens outside (bank transfer, cash...).
settle.stale: The balance changed since you opened this screen. Check the new amount and confirm again.

division.title: Splitting expenses
division.help: Changing the split doesn't rewrite old expenses: each one keeps its own.
division.proportionalHelp: Each pays a share according to income. It only works when both enter their income and agree.
division.incomeMineMissing: You still need to enter your income.
division.incomePartnerMissing: {{name}} still needs to enter their income.

consent.title: Split proportional to income
consent.body: With a proportional split, each person pays a share according to income. Since you both see each expense's percentage, whoever knows their own income can work out the other's. Only turn it on if you both agree. Either of you can withdraw agreement at any time.

income.title: Your monthly income
income.privacy: Only you see this amount. It is used only to work out the proportional split, if you both want it.
income.label: Monthly income (optional)
income.notifyPartner: The split is proportional to income. If you change or delete your income, your partner will be notified (without seeing amounts) and the split may go back to equal.

recurring.title: Fixed expenses
recurring.help: Rent, internet, subscriptions: the expense appears by itself every month, on the agreed day.
recurring.dayHint: In shorter months it falls on the last day.
recurring.startInvalid: It can't start before the current month.
recurring.editHint: Editing applies from the next months on: what was already generated doesn't change. If this month's day has passed, the expense appears right away.

bills.amountHint: An electricity bill, for example, only has an amount later.
bills.remindersHint: Reminders are automatic: 3 days before and on the due date, at 9 am.
bills.emptyBody: Add a bill and the app reminds you before it's due.

pay.title: Pay {{title}}
pay.hint: This logs a shared expense, split by the default split.

notice.splitFallback: The proportional split isn't available right now; we split it equally.
notice.syncPending: Bill saved. Reminders will be redone within an hour.
notice.nextBill: Bill paid. The next one is due {{date}}.

summary.mineHint: Only your personal expenses. Your partner's don't count, not even the ones they left visible.
summary.emptyBody: Once there are expenses, the summary shows where the money went.
summary.installmentsHint: Installments count in the month of each one.
summary.byCardHint: Only your cards show up. What your partner paid on their card is not listed here.

budget.title: Budget by category
budget.help: The limit applies every month and covers shared expenses only. Personal expenses don't count. You get a heads-up at 80% and 100%.

export.title: Download a copy of your data
export.help: Your visible expenses, the settlements and the categories (and only your own income).

shopping.title: Log the shopping expense
shopping.hint: The category is Groceries. The amount is what you type here: the shopping list doesn't keep prices.
